description: Locked four-version database baseline for the mysql-tidb-ddl-completion milestone (issue #79). Independent of per-task manifests: every ddl-golden run must cover these anchors and CLI dialects regardless of what a task manifest declares. Editing this file shrinks the milestone denominator and must be a visible review diff. expected_image_digest locks the immutable repo digest each anchor must resolve to (R2: no floating tag may substitute for the pinned identity); platform locks the expected os/arch the anchor image runs on for the pinned host class.
